_meta.description: GTA VI character personality profiles for the YOUinGTA6 matcher.
_meta.disclaimer: The biographical 'canonical_bio' fields paraphrase information from Rockstar Games' publicly released trailers and character descriptions. All numeric trait values are initial, configurable scoring assumptions created for this fan project. They are NOT scientifically established measurements and are NOT claims about the characters' real psychology. Rockstar Games is not affiliated with this project.

characters.name: Jason Duval
characters.tagline: Calculated mind. Independent spirit. Dangerous ambition.
characters.canonical_bio: A former soldier living in the Grassrivers who works for local drug runners while trying to build a better life for himself. Jason is a skilled driver and fighter who keeps to himself and is drawn into a high-stakes robbery plot.
characters.interpretation_note: Traits emphasize self-reliance, risk tolerance and quiet competence, interpreted from his military background and reluctance to trust others.

characters.name: Lucia Caminos
characters.tagline: Hardened by the past. Hungry for a fresh start.
characters.canonical_bio: A former prison fighter recently released and determined to leave her past behind. Lucia is tough, driven and willing to do whatever it takes to get the life she believes she deserves.
characters.interpretation_note: Traits emphasize determination, rebellion and loyalty, interpreted from her fighting background and desire for a clean slate.

characters.name: Cal Hampton
characters.tagline: Offline brain. Online chaos. Zero filter.
characters.canonical_bio: Jason's childhood friend, a conspiracy theorist and stoner who spends his days floating on a boat and ranting about the government and the world. Cal is eccentric, anxious and fiercely loyal to Jason.
characters.interpretation_note: Traits emphasize humor, creativity, eccentricity and low conventional ambition, interpreted from his paranoid, free-spirited personality.

characters.name: Raul Bautista
characters.tagline: Every move rehearsed. Every risk calculated.
characters.canonical_bio: A veteran bank robber and respected figure in the criminal underworld who plans elaborate heists. Raul is meticulous, controlled and insists on doing things the right way.
characters.interpretation_note: Traits emphasize strategy, patience and professionalism, interpreted from his reputation as a careful, experienced planner.

characters.name: Brian Heder
characters.canonical_bio: A former military man turned drug runner who has taken Jason under his wing. Brian is seasoned, commands respect and lives by a strict code built over years in the life.
characters.interpretation_note: Traits emphasize confidence, networking and calculated risk, interpreted from his role as a mentor and established operator.

characters.name: Boobie Ike
characters.tagline: Built an empire out of pure hustle.
characters.canonical_bio: A prolific entrepreneur who turned a wrestling promotion into a nightclub, a real-estate portfolio and a record label. Boobie is a charismatic hustler who spot opportunities everywhere.
characters.interpretation_note: Traits emphasize entrepreneurship, charisma and ambition, interpreted from his rags-to-riches business story.

characters.name: Dre'Quan Priest
characters.tagline: Visionary operator. Master of the long game.
characters.canonical_bio: A music manager and producer who guides the rising duo Bae-Luxe and Roxy. Dre'Quan is ambitious, well-connected and always thinking several moves ahead in the industry.
characters.interpretation_note: Traits emphasize strategy, ambition and social intelligence, interpreted from his management role and industry connections.

characters.name: Bae-Luxe
characters.tagline: Star power, sharp tongue, bigger dreams.
characters.canonical_bio: One half of a rising music duo on the verge of a major deal. Bae-Luxe is glamorous, talented and unafraid to say exactly what is on her mind.
characters.interpretation_note: Traits emphasize confidence, creativity and expressiveness, interpreted from her performer persona and outspoken attitude.

characters.name: Roxy
characters.canonical_bio: The other half of the rising music duo, known for her rebellious streak and larger-than-life energy. Roxy lives in the moment and never holds back.
characters.interpretation_note: Traits emphasize impulsiveness, humor and rebelliousness, interpreted from her wild, free-spirited performer persona.
